svg.text: Two real dark scans of the covered R8486, 2026-11-10: 13:20 (13:20 rules) and 16:36 (16:36 rules)
(a) dark rate against |threshold|, raw rate = counts / live time, +-1 sigma Poisson
Above 6 mV each threshold is 30 s and holds 0-77 counts.
16:36 went to 2 mV steps at 7.2 mV and stopped at 18 mV;
13:20 kept 0.4 mV steps to 15.2 mV and ran to 36 mV.
(b) rate ratio 16:36 / 13:20 at the levels both scans measured, +-1 sigma Poisson
0.4-2.4 mV (one 10-20 ms period each): agree, max |z| = 2.7 over 11 levels
Source: out/01_real_levels.csv, out/05_tube_*.csv. In (b) 18 mV (13:20: 1 count, ratio 5 +- 5) is not drawn.
